headline: Nigeria Expects $280 Million in Signature Bonuses From 2026 Licensing Round
summary: Nigeria projects raising up to $280 million in signature bonuses from 40 offered oil and gas blocks. The licensing round aims to boost domestic energy production and government revenue.
why: Nigeria is Africa's largest crude oil producer, deriving significant government revenues from hydrocarbon block auctions.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Signature bonuses generate immediate non-tax revenue for the federal government treasury.
